1.text: A 64.34-point win over Cooked by Flowers puts your 159.22 in the books. Dak Prescott and Nico Collins put up 69.82 between them. Imagine scoring that much and still letting a team called Cooked by Flowers beat you on defense.
1.quip: Imagine scoring that much and still letting a team called Cooked by Flowers beat you on defense.

2.text: You finished 2nd in weekly scoring and took the matchup by 51.34. George Pickens led your starters with 43.50 points from the FLEX slot. At this point the team name is false advertising and somebody ought to call trading standards.
2.quip: At this point the team name is false advertising and somebody ought to call trading standards.

3.text: I love land handed you a 61.34-point loss despite your 81.62. On the bench, Patrick Mahomes outscored Drake Maye by 42.40 and was eligible for the same QB slot. You paid for the whole quarterback and used him as a drinks holder while losing to an empty chair.
3.quip: You paid for the whole quarterback and used him as a drinks holder while losing to an empty chair.

4.text: You set the league high at 186.26 and beat Zentio by 79.48. Christian McCaffrey and Brock Purdy put up 83.96 between them. Very neighborly of you to mow the lawn, trim the hedge and bury the opposition underneath it.
4.quip: Very neighborly of you to mow the lawn, trim the hedge and bury the opposition underneath it.

5.text: Love thy Nabers handed you a 79.48-point loss despite your 106.78. On the bench, Alvin Kamara outscored Corey Kiner by 13.90 and was eligible for the same RB slot. The running back you needed was on the bench, presumably watching the same horror film as the rest of us.
5.quip: The running back you needed was on the bench, presumably watching the same horror film as the rest of us.

6.text: You finished 4th in weekly scoring and took the matchup by 40.04. Jahmyr Gibbs led your starters with 44.20 points from the RB slot. The scouting department appears to be a playlist with a draft button, and the worst part is that it works.
6.quip: The scouting department appears to be a playlist with a draft button, and the worst part is that it works.

7.text: To Infinity & Bijan handed you a 64.34-point loss despite your 94.88. On the bench, Omarion Hampton outscored Rhamondre Stevenson by 15.00 and was eligible for the same RB slot. Your defense nearly led the team in scoring, which is usually the part where the offense gets locked out of the group chat.
7.quip: Your defense nearly led the team in scoring, which is usually the part where the offense gets locked out of the group chat.

8.text: You beat rngbot1 by 61.34 with an empty starting slot (DEF). Joe Burrow and Ja'Marr Chase put up 74.26 between them. An empty defense and a win is a bold way to tell the group project you won’t be attending the meeting.
8.quip: An empty defense and a win is a bold way to tell the group project you won’t be attending the meeting.

9.text: Never Gonna Gibbs You Up handed you a 40.04-point loss despite your 113.94. On the bench, Pat Freiermuth outscored Sam LaPorta by 8.90 and was eligible for the same TE slot. You hailed the wrong tight end and still had to pay full fare.
9.quip: You hailed the wrong tight end and still had to pay full fare.

10.text: Your 119.96 would have beaten 4 other teams, but Down under performers put the win 51.34 points out of reach. Matthew Stafford and Tony Pollard put up 50.66 between them. Somewhere there’s a parallel league where this lineup wins, so congratulations on your imaginary parade.
10.quip: Somewhere there’s a parallel league where this lineup wins, so congratulations on your imaginary parade.

notebook.evidence: McCaffrey turned it into a 74-yard touchdown
notebook.summary: McCaffrey stayed in to block, slipped free, and turned a short pass from Brock Purdy into a 74-yard touchdown against Dallas.

notebook.evidence: Jahmyr Gibbs finished with 153 rushing yards (7.0 avg.) and two touchdowns
notebook.summary: Gibbs gained 153 rushing yards and another 99 as a receiver against New England in Munich. Both of his touchdowns came on the ground.

notebook.evidence: Joe Burrow lit up the Cincinnati night sky, completing 35-of-44 passes for 409 yards and four touchdowns.
notebook.summary: Burrow threw for 409 yards against Pittsburgh, with 231 of them going to Ja’Marr Chase. Cincinnati’s next stop is Washington on Monday night.

4-6.evidence: The Bucs are allowing on average just 79.1 yards per game on the ground
4-6.summary: Tampa Bay had held eight straight teams below 100 rushing yards entering Detroit’s game. Gibbs had cleared 100 himself in four of five. Watch his receiving work if Tampa closes the inside lanes.

3-5.evidence: Patrick Mahomes threw for 348 yards and five touchdowns against Atlanta
3-5.summary: Arizona entered the week having allowed nine touchdown passes of 20 yards or longer, the most in the NFL. That gives Mahomes a downfield opening. With Kansas City receivers on the other fantasy roster, a touchdown pass can pay both managers on the same play.

1-8.evidence: he has the highest completion percentage in the NFL against the blitz (73.4%)
1-8.summary: Washington sent extra rushers on 42.1% of dropbacks. Burrow had completed 73.4% of his passes against the blitz. Watch who gets the quick throw when Washington brings pressure on Monday night.

2-9.evidence: the second most run stops (52) and third most hustle stops (11)
2-9.summary: Miami arrived in Buffalo with linebacker Jordyn Brooks second in the league in run stops. On short yardage, watch whether Josh Allen keeps the ball or gets it out quickly. His rushing work is a separate way for CashCab2 to score.

7-10.evidence: Justin Jefferson, who saw his most targets (13)
7-10.summary: Jefferson drew 13 targets with Kirk Cousins back at quarterback. In Mexico City against San Francisco, the question is whether that volume carries over. In a full-PPR league, catches can swing the matchup before a receiver even reaches the end zone.
